title: 啄木鸟蒸馏：弱模型诊断强模型推理错误
summary: 本文提出Woodpecker Distillation，一种弱到强的训练框架。它利用弱探针模型在相同推理前缀下生成成功与失败的对比补丁，构建修正性的教师分布，并蒸馏到强模型中。实验表明，该方法在数学推理基准上持续提升强模型性能，优于直接模仿基线。
summary_en: This paper proposes Woodpecker Distillation, a weak-to-strong training framework that contrasts successful and unsuccessful weak-model patches at the same reasoning prefix to construct a corrective teacher distribution, which is distilled into the strong model. Experiments on math reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements over direct imitation baselines.
